description_for_human: Reads pull requests, issues, commits, and search results from GitHub via the GitHub Remote MCP Server (OAuth-protected).
description_for_model: Plugin that delegates engineering-intelligence queries to GitHub's hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/. Use this plugin whenever a user asks anything about pull requests, issues, commits, code search, repositories, or GitHub users. The plugin runs strictly within the signed-in user's GitHub OAuth scope (read:user, repo). Always call `get_me` once at the start of a session if the user's GitHub login is not already known. For activity questions, prefer `search_pull_requests` and `search_issues` with GitHub search qualifiers (e.g. `is:pr author:@me state:open updated:>YYYY-MM-DD`). For depth on a specific pull request (reviews, status checks, comments) call `pull_request_read`.

functions.name: get_me
functions.description: Get the authenticated GitHub user's profile (login, name, email, ids).

functions.name: search_pull_requests
functions.description: Search pull requests across GitHub using qualifiers like is:pr, author:@me, state:open, updated:>YYYY-MM-DD.

functions.name: list_pull_requests
functions.description: List pull requests for a specific repository (owner, repo).

functions.name: pull_request_read
functions.description: Read full details of a specific pull request including reviews, status checks, and comments.

functions.name: search_issues
functions.description: Search issues across GitHub using qualifiers (is:issue, author, assignee, label, state, updated).

functions.name: list_issues
functions.description: List issues for a specific repository.

functions.name: issue_read
functions.description: Read full details of a specific issue including comments and timeline.

functions.name: list_commits
functions.description: List commits on a branch of a repository.

functions.name: get_commit
functions.description: Get full details (files, stats, parents) for a single commit.

functions.name: search_commits
functions.description: Search commits across GitHub using qualifiers (author, committer, repo, date).

functions.name: search_code
functions.description: Search code across GitHub using qualifiers (path, language, repo).

functions.name: search_repositories
functions.description: Search GitHub repositories by name, topic, owner, language, etc.

functions.name: search_users
functions.description: Search GitHub users by login, name, location, or other profile attributes.

functions.name: get_file_contents
functions.description: Fetch the contents of a file from a repository at a given ref.
